title: Real headline, or bubble?
excerpt: Five market headlines. Thirty seconds per call. Pick Real or Bubble, set your conviction and score up to 500 bps. A free daily finance game. No sign-up.
content_html:
THE DAILY FINANCE GAME

Five market headlines a day. Some happened. Some we made up. Bet your conviction.

Play today's round

Five calls. 30 seconds each. No sign-up.

Know the news.Know your conviction.

A daily reality check.

01 — 03

1Make the call

Swipe left for Bubble.
Right for Real.

2Size your conviction

Further means surer.
From 55% to all in.

3See the truth

Check the source.
Mark your P&L.

Be right. Size it right.

Conviction pays. Overconfidence sends an invoice.
Five cards. A maximum of +500 bps a day.

Scoring in basis points by conviction
ConvictionRightWrong
55%+19−1
60%+36−4
70%+64−16
80%+84−36
90%+96−64
100%+100−100

Before the opening bell.

Is this free?

Yes. Five headlines, no account, no subscription. Your only exposure is your pride.

Are the real headlines actually real?

Every real card links to its original source at the reveal. We check the claim and its numbers before publishing.

How does conviction affect my score?

The further you move the card, the bigger your position. A correct call earns up to 100 bps. A wrong one can lose 100. Five cards, maximum +500.

Can I change my answer?

You have 30 seconds per headline. Adjust before locking in. At zero, your selected call locks automatically; no call costs 100 bps. Once revealed, the trade is final.

Where do my stats go?

They stay in your browser on this device. No cookies, no accounts, no personal data. Clearing your browser data clears your record.
